description: This horizontal bar chart from the paper "Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models" illustrates the number of tasks (# tasks) for which each language family or group was evaluated. The vertical axis lists the language families in descending order of task count, from top to bottom: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The horizontal axis represents the number of tasks, ranging from 0 to 80 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each bar's length corresponds to the number of tasks for that group: IE-Slavic has the longest bar at approximately 79 tasks, followed by IE-Romance at about 47 tasks, and IE-Germanic at approximately 45 tasks. The Uralic group has about 20 tasks, IE-Baltic has about 17 tasks, IE-other has about 15 tasks, IE-Indic has about 10 tasks, Semitic has about 9 tasks, Turkic has about 5 tasks, and Basque has the shortest bar at approximately 3 tasks. The bars are color-coded, with IE-Slavic in light blue, IE-Romance in dark blue, IE-Germanic in light green, Uralic in dark green, IE-Baltic in light pink, IE-other in red, IE-Indic in light orange, Semitic in orange, Turkic in light purple, and Basque in dark purple. The bars are sorted in descending order by their length, and no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color and length.
